critique_history.assessment:
- Several top rails visibly float above the rack; remove them or attach ties directly between uprights.
- Upright perforations are effectively invisible; rebuild the posts with clearly readable repeated openings.
- The top silhouette is cluttered and uneven; keep all structural members aligned to consistent rack levels.
The model clearly reads as a tall industrial warehouse rack with a complete dark steel frame, repeated beam levels, perforated uprights, supports, and attached bracing.
